property_summary: When nft is not set (remains address(0)), availableForFlashLoan(token, tokenId) returns false for any token because ownerOf(address(0), tokenId) will revert or return unexpected result; the reference with nft set properly checks ownership against the pool address.
change_summary: Replace the line setting `nft = _nft` with a comment or no-op, so `nft` remains the default value (address(0)).
